presetQA.response: We love animals, but for hygiene and safety reasons, pets are not allowed inside the salon (including dogs, cats, fish, or any other animals). Registered assistance or service dogs are always welcome!

We aim to make our salon welcoming and comfortable for everyone. Our studio has built-in accessibility arrangements, including step-free access and a wheelchair ramp at the entrance.

If you have specific needs, accommodations, or preferences (such as sensory-friendly appointments for autism/ADHD, quiet spaces, or mobility support), please reach out to us directly so we can prepare for your visit:
• Phone: 01234 567890
• Email: bloom@hairstudios.co.uk
Yes, you can take the bus! The Mill Street bus stop is located directly in front of our shop.
Yes, you can get the train here! Mill Street train station is just a short 5-minute walk away from us.

We are located at 14 Mill Street, past the post office.

• Bus: The Mill Street bus stop is directly in front of the salon.

We offer complimentary tea, coffee, and Wi-Fi for all clients during their visit!
We offer a 15-minute leeway for appointments. If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, your appointment will unfortunately be cancelled.
You can email us at bloom@hairstudios.co.uk for inquiries and booking support.
You can call us directly on 01234 567890 during our working hours.
To reschedule or move an appointment, tap the link in your confirmation SMS, or call us at 01234 567890 at least 24 hours prior with no fee.
You can cancel your booking up to 24 hours in advance free of charge via your confirmation SMS link or by calling us.

We're open Sun 10am–4pm, and Mon–Sat 9am–6pm!

presetQA.response:
To book an appointment:
1. Select a service from our menu.
2. Tap 'Book Now' on our website or call 01234 567890.
3. Choose your preferred date & time slot!
You can book directly on our website using the 'Book Now' button, or tell me what service you're looking for!
We accept walk-ins if space permits, but booking ahead guarantees your preferred slot.

Our main rates:
• Cut & Blow-Dry: £35
• Full Head Highlights: £75
• Highlights + Cut Package: £95
• Dry Trim: £20
A full head of highlights is £75, or £95 with a cut and blow-dry included.
A standard cut & blow-dry is £35, or a dry trim is £20.

We are located at 14 Mill Street, past the post office.

• Bus: The Mill Street bus stop is directly in front of the salon.
• Train: Mill Street train station is just a 5-minute walk away.
• Driving: Free parking is available round the back!
